breakfast.name: Apple Pie Smoothie
ingredients: 1 red delicious apple, cut into pieces
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender and pulse until smooth.

lunch.name: Buttermilk Skillet Fried Chicken
ingredients: 3-4 pounds of chicken pieces : drumsticks, tights and breast
steps: Clean all the chicken pieces well, remove skin if desired. Using 1 tablespoon salt and  tablespoon pepper, season the chicken well all over.In a medium bowl whisk the buttermilk, egg and  cup of water.In a large glass baking pan mix together: flour,1 tablespoon salt,  tablespoon pepper, paprika and cornstarch.

Mix well.Dip chicken in buttermilk then on flour mixture.  shaking off any excess flour.In a large heavy bottom skillet heat the oil to a depth of . When oil is hot but not burning add the chicken to the skillet making sure that it is not crowding the pan. Fry chicken turning with thongs so it brown evenly. About 10 to 13 minutes.When the chicken is done place on a paper plate and serve immediately.

dinner.name: Marinated Flat Iron Steak
ingredients: Fresh herbs: rosemary, sage, marjoram, thyme, chives ( anything in hand)
steps: Cut the flat iron steak lengthwise to form two equal strips.
Place all the above ingredients in a large baking pan, or Ziploc bag.

Add the meat to it and place in the refrigerator for an hour or more.Start the BBQ . When temperature reaches high, add the steaks. Cover and cook for 3 minutes.Turn the steaks and cook the other side for another 3 minutes, or to required doneness.
